Its only hope is finding a cure. Lauren's objective is simple: lead her team into the field and rescue survivors, filming their experiences so it can be used for research. But nothing could have prepared them for the mayhem they walk into. As they search for Uninfected, fend off the Infected with whatever weapons they can find, and fight for their lives, we see everything from their point of view - directly from their helmet cameras.

programme.desc: Western in which a former Texan sheriff (Luke Perry) sets out to capture the escaped convict who murdered his wife and son. Carrying the dead man back to his family, he discovers that his widowed sister and her son are under threat from an unscrupulous land baron (Thomas Howell) who wants their property for its water rights. The sheriff vows to protect them, only to find that the convict is among the land baron's hired help.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: Whether right whales, penguins or sea lions - for the birth of their young, many marine creatures are drawn to Argentina's nearly 5,000 kilometer coastline. programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: In Argentina's breathtaking, yet imposing wilderness, every day is a fight for survival. The terrain is rugged and parched. The air is thin. The weather can change in an instant. And then there are the predators. A female puma stalks a valley in search of guanaco, while a tarantula defends itself against a hungry armadillo. Foxes will scavenge what they can…until one of the world's largest vultures shows up. All the while, in the background, glaciers greedily hold on to the freshwater these animals so desperately need.

programme.title: Freaks & Creep
programme.desc: Typically South Africa is known for the Big Five: lions, leopards, buffalo, elephants and rhinos. But not for Lucy Cooke, advocate and avenger for the lesser-known and unloved animals of the world. Lucy's on a hunt for the more enigmatic Freaky Five: Cape vultures, sungazer girdled lizards, golden-brown baboon tarantulas, ground pangolins, and chacma baboons. The Freaky Five are all important to South Africans and their traditions. Mystical and mysterious, these five animals represent a side of South African culture that the tourists and conservation donors both often overlook. But Lucy Cooke is on a mission to change all of that!

programme.title: Freaks & Creep
programme.desc: Lucy Cooke is on a one-woman mission to show why the ugly, weird and overlooked animals of the world can be cute, cuddly and deserving of attention. Join her as she heads off to the rainforests of Borneo. Borneo is its own very unique crucible of weirdness - with countless strange creatures that can only be found there. Lucy's goal is get up close with the giant-nosed proboscis monkey to figure out why this creature looks so strange. Along the way, she finds many other "odd ones" - animals that have come up with all kinds of strange adaptations so they can survive in the forest of Borneo. Lucy finds dung beetles in action - eating dung; frogs that fly; a tarsier, with eyes that are bigger than its brain; and the wooly bat that makes its home is a carnivorous plant.

programme.desc: At the tender age of 14, Jack Randall left his home in the UK to work under the guidance of legendary wildlife expert Steve Irwin. Now an accomplished zoologist, Randall is continuing his studies into wild and exotic species, visiting harsh landscapes and unrelenting environments to explore these animal's behaviours. Using his bold and courageous approach, Randall gets up close and personal with deadly snakes, vicious crocodiles, boisterous kangaroos, fierce camels and many other dangerous species.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Watching too many ninja movies has brainwashed Leonard the koala. During the day, as he sleeps, he terrorizes everyone by sleepfighting (as opposed to sleepwalking). He makes the Rat King very angry by beating and humiliating him, and the oversized rodent is out for revenge. The penguins counter-program Leonard with a Lunacorn love movie marathon - is it enough to conquer all? // Private is left to babysit four adorable ducklings as the rest of the gang tries to crash a monster truck rally (unsuccessfully). The ducklings are a rowdy bunch and throw a party, inadvertently attracting party-crashing rats and wasps who attack the party food. Private and the ducklings become trapped in the lair with the food, and as the rats and wasps try to break in, Private must think fast - how can he combat both gangs at once?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Hazel and Jasmine have planned their very first sleepover but Dev Dimmadome threatens to throw an even better party! To draw her classmates' attention Hazel boasts that she lives in a luxury hotel and wishes her apartment building into The Wellsington Hotelsington Hotel. Now she must balance running the hottest hotel in Dimmadelphia and spending time with Jasmine and Winn before they check out of the friendship! // Hoping to win a class superlative, Hazel wishes to be famous at her school. Father Time cuts her a deal for 1,500 minutes of fame, but Principal Krentz is not happy about Hazel's celebrity status and threatens to transfer her if she doesn't stop being a "distraction" by the end of lunch. With tons of time left on her wish, Nick of Time arrives with a solution: if Hazel acts like a New Yorker, her remaining minutes will turn into New York Minutes and pass faster. Can Hazel act New Yorky enough to beat the clock?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: It's picture day at school! And on top of that, they're serving the most delicious pudding at lunchtime! Only problem is, Dev has control of the pudding supply and is hoarding it. Hazel takes the power back by wishing that everyone had an unlimited supply of pudding. Pudding is everywhere and Dev is out of business! But things take a turn when people can't stop eating it and turn into pudding zombies. Now Hazel not only has to save picture day, but also stop a pudding apocalypse! // Hoping to win "Most Spirited Hair" for School Spirit Week, Hazel wishes her hair had spirit! Cosmo and Wanda take this literally and give her hair a spirit, bringing it to life as Diana the Diva! When Hazel and Diana "butt heads" over how best to showcase her, Diana runs away. Hazel chases her all over town but can't catch her. Later, Diana shows up at Hazel's school aiming to enter the contest on her own. Hazel must find a way to reconcile with Diana if she hopes to win Diana back and win the contest.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Dev's dad, tech magnate Dale Dimmadome, creates an app designed to track kids' wants at the annual Founder's Day Festival, but Hazel shows up as an anomaly thanks to Cosmo and Wanda's wish granting. Dale programs giant robots to track her down.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: It's Kindness Day! Mr. Guzman announces that if all students complete one act of kindness, they'll get a class pizza party-and Hazel wants that pizza! But when Dev refuses to participate, Cosmo and Wanda call on the Pe-Az, a trio of alien diplomats, to reason with him. Despite their best efforts, Dev outsmarts the Pe-Az and uses their alien technology to get rid of all the pizza on Earth. // Hazel must take matters into her own hands to get to the bottom of Dev's surly attitude and save pizza! When Hazel makes a wish to understand why Dev acts the way he does, she gets paired with him for a class scavenger hunt. They struggle to work together, but, as the day goes on, they develop a friendship. However, that falls apart when Dev's dad, Dale, belittles their effort, causing Dev to turn on Hazel again to save face. Will Dev be able to overcome his pride and finish the project, or will his issues with his dad tank both their grades?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Having filled up another wish card, Hazel is enjoying a fun, fantasy wish. Meanwhile, Cookie, the fairy who got bested by Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda after their Wish Trials, is setting a trap for our trio. She tricks them into publicly talking about magic at a fake museum exhibit, records the evidence, and then takes them to Fairy Court. Now, Hazel must prove that Cosmo and Wanda are innocent, or else lose them forever. // Frustrated by her mom's split attention between work and home, Hazel wishes to be her assistant to spend more time with her. Cosmo and Wanda turn Hazel into an adult, and she spends the day struggling to fulfill her duties. Even though being a working adult is hard, Hazel is excited to be spending so much quality time with Angela. But when the puppet standing in for Hazel at school gets called into the nurse's office, Angela rushes off to take care of it and Hazel must give the presentation instead!

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. programme.desc: Sette Oscar e un Golden Globe al film di fantascienza di Alfonso Cuaron, con Sandra Bullock e George Clooney. La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

Edgar Hoover: leggendario capo dell'FBI per quasi 50 anni, dal 1924 al 1972, sotto ben otto presidenti degli Stati Uniti. Il ritratto pubblico e privato di un uomo, e della sua strenua lotta contro la criminalità e il mondo dei gangster. Un uomo, considerato il più potente d'America, che non si fermò davanti a nulla pur di proteggere il proprio Paese. Anche a costo di infrangere ogni regola, scritta e non.

programme.title: Tutti pazzi per l'oro
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Kate Hudson in una commedia avventurosa. All'inseguimento dell'inestimabile 'Dote della regina', un cacciatore di tesori si imbatte nella sua ex moglie.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: 7 Oscar e Orso d'argento a Berlino a un'epica love story con Gwyneth Paltrow e un grande cast. Londra, 1593. In crisi creativa, Shakespeare trova l'ispirazione grazie all'amore per Viola.

programme.title: A cena da amici
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid e Andie MacDowell in un film di Norman Jewison sull'autenticità del rapporto di coppia. Il matrimonio di Gabe e Karen entra in crisi quando due loro amici si separano.

programme.title: Sei mai stata sulla luna?
programme.desc: Raoul Bova e Liz Solari in una commedia romantica di Paolo Genovese. Una donna in carriera vorrebbe vendere la masseria che ha ereditato, ma deve sfrattare un affascinante contadino.

programme.title: Duplicity
programme.desc: Clive Owen e Julia Roberts in una commedia intessuta di doppio gioco. Due spie industriali, ex agenti segreti ed ex amanti, uniscono i loro intenti per impadronirsi di una formula segreta.

programme.title: Emma
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Jane Austen, una storia di intese amorose con Gwyneth Paltrow. 1800: una giovane aristocratica inglese aiuta una ragazza timida a trovare l'uomo giusto. Oscar alle musiche.

programme.title: Vicino all’orizzonte
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di Jessica Koch, un teen-movie ispirato a una storia vera con Luna Wedler e Jannik Schumann. Un oscuro segreto rende impossibile il legame fra Jessica e l'affascinante Danny.

programme.title: Tutti pazzi per l'oro
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Kate Hudson in una commedia avventurosa. All'inseguimento dell'inestimabile 'Dote della regina', un cacciatore di tesori si imbatte nella sua ex moglie.

programme.title: Mamma mia! - Ci risiamo
programme.desc: Tornano Amanda Seyfried, Meryl Streep e Colin Firth nel sequel del musical scandito dalle canzoni degli Abba. Sull'isola greca di Kalokairi, Sophie e' alle prese con la ristrutturazione dell'hotel di famiglia e soffre per la mancanza di Sky, partito per uno stage di sei settimane negli Stati Uniti. Il ragazzo vorrebbe che lei lo raggiungesse, ma Sophie non vuole lasciare l'isola per non mancare di rispetto alla madre, Donna, scomparsa un anno prima. Alla vigilia dell'inaugurazione dell'albergo, tuttavia, un violento uragano si abbatte su Kalokairi.

programme.title: Aline - La voce dell'amore
programme.desc: Valerie Lemercier dirige e interpreta un biopic ispirato alla vita di Celine Dion. Quebec, anni 60: dotata di una voce prodigiosa, la piccola Aline viene scoperta da un noto produttore.

programme.title: Matrimonio con sorpresa
programme.desc: Commedia targata HBO. Un imbroglione seduce la figlia di un senatore degli Stati Uniti per impadronirsi dei fondi del padre. Dopo il matrimonio si accorge pero' che ne e' davvero innamorato.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Speciale
programme.desc: Jurassic World - Questo O Quello - Jurassic World.

programme.title: A cena da amici
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid e Andie MacDowell in un film di Norman Jewison sull'autenticità del rapporto di coppia. Il matrimonio di Gabe e Karen entra in crisi quando due loro amici si separano.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Hugh Grant nell'amabile commedia romantica di Roger Michell scritta da Richard Curtis. Un timido librario londinese incontra una diva di Hollywood... e sboccia l'amore.

programme.title: Emma
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Jane Austen, una storia di intese amorose con Gwyneth Paltrow. 1800: una giovane aristocratica inglese aiuta una ragazza timida a trovare l'uomo giusto. Oscar alle musiche.

programme.title: Il grande Gatsby
programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann (il regista di "Mouline Rouge!") dirige Leonardo DiCaprio, Carey Mulligan e Tobey Maguire nello sfarzoso adattamento, vincitore di due Oscar, del celebre romanzo di Francis S. Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. America, anni '20: un aspirante scrittore, Nick Carraway, entra nel mondo di Jay Gatsby, un misterioso milionario ossessionato dall'amore impossibile per Daisy: la donna da lui amata e che vorrebbe riconquistare. Nick verra' a contatto con l'atmosfera festosa dell'eta' del jazz che si consuma in illusioni, malinconie e sogni effimeri.

programme.title: Ex
programme.desc: Fausto Brizzi dirige una commedia corale con Claudio Bisio, Nancy Brilli e Alessandro Gassmann. La ricomparsa degli ex mette in crisi il rapporto di sei coppie.

programme.title: Che cosa aspettarsi quando si aspetta
programme.desc: Cameron Diaz, Jennifer Lopez e Anna Kendrick in una romantica commedia corale. Cinque coppie in dolce attesa si preparano alle gioie e alle preoccupazioni del loro futuro da genitori.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: Richard Gere e Jennifer Lopez per una commedia romantica a passo di danza. Lui e' un avvocato di successo con una bella famiglia ma si sente infelice. Lei e' l'insegnante di ballo che potrebbe aiutarlo a colmare il suo vuoto interiore.

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: Juliette Binoche e Johnny Depp in una 'dolce' commedia che stimola i sensi. In un paesino della Francia, una donna decide di aprire una cioccolateria che riscuote un grandissimo successo.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Hugh Grant nell'amabile commedia romantica di Roger Michell scritta da Richard Curtis. Un timido librario londinese incontra una diva di Hollywood... e sboccia l'amore.

programme.title: Corro da te
programme.desc: Riccardo Milani dirige Pierfrancesco Favino e Miriam Leone in una commedia brillante e dissacrante. Gianni e' un seduttore seriale, ma l'incontro con Chiara cambiera' tutto.

programme.title: La mia Africa
programme.desc: Sette Oscar all’intenso dramma di Sydney Pollack con Meryl Streep e Robert Redford, tratto dall’autobiografia di Karen Blixen. La scrittrice ripercorre gli anni passati in Kenya.

programme.title: La casa sul lago del tempo
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves in una love story che trascende lo spazio e il tempo. Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

programme.title: Sogno di una notte di mezza età
programme.desc: Irriverente commedia con Gerard Depardieu, diretta e interpretata da Daniel Auteuil. Un uomo sposato, dalla fervida immaginazione, inizia a fantasticare sulla giovane fidanzata dell'amico.

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: Juliette Binoche e Johnny Depp in una 'dolce' commedia che stimola i sensi. In un paesino della Francia, una donna decide di aprire una cioccolateria che riscuote un grandissimo successo.

programme.title: Il materiale emotivo
programme.desc: Commedia di e con Sergio Castellitto, Berenice Bejo e Matilda De Angelis. Parigi: la vita monotona del proprietario di una libreria riceve una scossa grazie a un'esuberante attrice.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: Richard Gere e Jennifer Lopez per una commedia romantica a passo di danza. Lui e' un avvocato di successo con una bella famiglia ma si sente infelice. Lei e' l'insegnante di ballo che potrebbe aiutarlo a colmare il suo vuoto interiore.

programme.title: Ex - Amici come prima!
programme.desc: Commedia corale di Carlo Vanzina con Alessandro Gassmann ed Enrico Brignano in un intreccio di storie d'amore clandestine e ritorni di fiamma tra architetti, avvocati e psicanalisti.

programme.title: Vi presento Joe Black
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins e Brad Pitt in una suggestiva pellicola sull'amore e la morte. Un miliardario accoglie il tenebroso fidanzato della figlia, ma è ignaro della sua vera identità.

programme.title: La casa sul lago del tempo
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves in una love story che trascende lo spazio e il tempo. Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

programme.title: Downton Abbey
programme.desc: Dall'omonima serie tv di grande successo, i sofisticati intrighi della famiglia Crawley. Gli aristocratici padroni di casa si mobilitano per l'imminente visita dei reali d’Inghilterra.

programme.title: La mia Africa
programme.desc: Sette Oscar all’intenso dramma di Sydney Pollack con Meryl Streep e Robert Redford, tratto dall’autobiografia di Karen Blixen. La scrittrice ripercorre gli anni passati in Kenya.

programme.title: Amici, amanti e...
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Ghostbusters" una commedia piccante con due sex symbol di Hollywood, Natalie Portman e Ashton Kutcher. Adam scopre che suo padre (Kevin Kline) ha sedotto la sua fidanzata. Davanti a un simile trauma, il ragazzo si ubriaca e finisce a casa di Emma. I due, amici di lunga data, finiscono a letto insieme e decidono di instaurare una relazione puramente fisica, senza alcun coinvolgimento: ci si diverte ma i sentimenti devono esser tenuti ben lontani. Un reciproco accordo che sembra anche funzionare, ma sara' sempre piu' difficile tenere a bada il cuore...

programme.title: Se scappi, ti sposo
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Richard Gere di nuovo insieme nella commedia romantica dal regista di "Pretty Woman". Ike Graham e' un cronista di New York in cerca di un'idea per il prossimo pezzo da consegnare al suo capo, la sua ex moglie. Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Quattro pellicole natalizie, che hanno riscosso il successo di pubblico, disponibili su Sky Cinema.

programme.title: Destino fatale
programme.desc: Agrodolci scherzi del destino in un film HBO con Susan Sarandon e Stephen Dorff. Un giovane rapinatore prende in ostaggio una donna annoiata dalla vita. Ma la loro fuga finisce per unirli.

programme.title: Una lunga domenica di passioni
programme.desc: Jean Pierre Jeunet dirige Audrey Tautou in un toccante dramma sentimentale. Una donna affronta gli orrori della Prima Guerra Mondiale per cercare il fidanzato, dato per disperso.

programme.title: Il quiz dell'amore
programme.desc: Avventure e disavventure sentimentali per James McAvoy (il giovane Professor X della saga di "X-Men"). Inghilterra, Anni'80. Brian viene ammesso all'Universita' di Bristol nonostante venga da una famiglia di umili origini. Appassionato di quiz sin da bambino, entra nella cerchia ristretta degli studenti in procinto di partecipare in tv al famoso "University Challenge". Ma alla domanda piu' difficile dovra' rispondere il suo cuore, diviso fra l'avvenente Alice e l'altrettanto affascinante Rebecca. Tratto dal romanzo "Le domande di Brian" di David Nicholls, autore anche della sceneggiatura.

programme.title: Promises
programme.desc: Amanda Sthers dirige Pierfrancesco Favino, Kelly Reilly e Jean Reno in una storia d’amore che rincorre il tempo, tratta da un suo romanzo. La vita di un uomo, padre di famiglia dal passato difficile, viene travolta dall’incontro con una donna in procinto di sposarsi.

programme.title: Finché notte non ci separi
programme.desc: Pilar Fogliati e Filippo Scicchitano in una commedia romantica tra le strade di Roma. Un biglietto nella tasca di lui farà trascorrere a due neosposi una movimentata prima notte.

programme.title: Scent of a Woman - Profumo di donna
programme.desc: Oscar ad Al Pacino e 3 Golden Globe per il remake americano di "Profumo di donna". Uno studente accetta di occuparsi di un ex ufficiale cieco e dal carattere impossibile.

programme.title: Quel mostro di suocera
programme.desc: Jennifer Lopez e Jane Fonda in una brillante commedia a tinte rosa. Una ragazza sta per sposare l'uomo ideale, ma l'invadente futura suocera farà di tutto per renderle la vita un inferno.

programme.title: Mia moglie è un fantasma
programme.desc: Brillante commedia con Dan Stevens, Leslie Mann, Isla Fisher e Judi Dench basata sull’omonimo racconto. Per uscire dal blocco creativo, uno scrittore si rivolge a un’eccentrica medium, che rievoca lo spirito dell’ex moglie. Questa presenza susciterà le gelosie dell’attuale consorte.

programme.title: Se scappi, ti sposo
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Richard Gere di nuovo insieme nella commedia romantica dal regista di "Pretty Woman". Ike Graham e' un cronista di New York in cerca di un'idea per il prossimo pezzo da consegnare al suo capo, la sua ex moglie. Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.title: Un giorno come tanti
programme.desc: Jason Reitman dirige Kate Winslet, Josh Brolin e Tobey Maguire in un film dal romanzo di Joyce Maynard. Abbandonata dal marito con un figlio adolescente, Adele accoglie in casa un evaso.

programme.title: Tre amiche
programme.desc: Un cast al femminile capitanato da Camille Cottin in un film presentato in concorso a Venezia. Le dinamiche sentimentali di 3 quarantenni vengono sconvolte da un evento inaspettato.

programme.title: Scent of a Woman - Profumo di donna
programme.desc: Oscar ad Al Pacino e 3 Golden Globe per il remake americano di "Profumo di donna". Uno studente accetta di occuparsi di un ex ufficiale cieco e dal carattere impossibile.

programme.title: Amore a seconda vista
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Famiglia all'improvviso", un'incantevole commedia romantica con Francois Civil e Joséphine Japy. Un famoso romanziere si risveglia in un mondo parallelo e capisce di dover riconquistare Olivia, la donna che ama e che ha già sposato nella sua vita originale.

programme.title: Trilogia di Istanbul - Meze
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek ritorna alla sua terra natale con tre cortometraggi. I mezé sono tipici antipasti turchi che vengono condivisi a tavola così come la vita.

programme.title: Gran Torino
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood firma l'ennesimo capolavoro della sua folgorante carriera. Walt Kowalski è un veterano della guerra che ha appena perso la moglie. Le uniche sue passioni sono il fedele cane e la sua auto: una Ford Gran Torino che tiene con cura maniacale. Non sopporta i suoi vicini asiatici, men che meno il giovane Thao che ha provato a rubargli la sua amata macchina per esser ammesso in una gang. Ma sarà lui a salvare il ragazzo dal branco, divenendo il suo mentore. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior film straniero.

programme.title: Uno di noi
programme.desc: Kevin Costner e Diane Lane in un dramma dai risvolti thrilling. Uno sceriffo e la moglie lasciano il ranch nel Montana per salvare la nuora e il nipote da una famiglia di criminali.

programme.title: In viaggio con Adele
programme.desc: Alessandro Haber, Sara Serraiocco e Isabella Ferrari in un toccante road movie. Un anziano attore scopre di avere una figlia e parte con lei per un viaggio che cambiera' le loro vite.

programme.title: Fire Squad - Incubo di fuoco
programme.desc: Spettacolare film drammatico con Jeff Bridges, Josh Brolin e Jennifer Connelly ispirato alle vicende di un gruppo di pompieri addestrati nel combattere gli incendi di montagna. Un pauroso incendio in Arizona sara' la loro tragica prova del fuoco.

programme.title: Era mio figlio (2024)
programme.desc: Richard Gere e Diane Kruger in una pellicola sul rimpianto di Savi Gabizon. Un ricco magnate scopre di aver avuto un figlio, morto in un incidente, e decide di scavare nel suo passato.

programme.title: Bernard & Doris - Complici amici
programme.desc: Susan Sarandon e Ralph Fiennes in un'eccentrica pellicola ispirata a una storia vera. Un'ereditiera instaura un insolito rapporto di amicizia e complicita' con il suo nuovo maggiordomo.

programme.title: Hereafter
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige Matt Damon e sonda il mistero della morte. La vita di un uomo che parla con i defunti si intreccia con il drammatico vissuto di una donna e di un bambino.

programme.title: Orlando
programme.desc: Daniele Vicari dirige una favola moderna con un intenso Michele Placido. In Belgio per rivedere il figlio ricoverato in ospedale, un anziano contadino scopre di avere una nipote.

programme.title: Still Life

Kayla guides them to look into the mirror and notice the beautiful things that make you, you! Everyone looks at themselves in the mirror and starts drawing what they see. They also learn their identity is about what you love to do. So, they add onto their self-portraits and then share their drawings with each other. Cookie Monster draws his blue fur, his googly eyes, and cookies. Charlie draws her blue eyes, curly blonde hair, tap shoes, and challah bread because it’s one of her favorite Jewish foods. Julia draws her straight hair, musical notes, paw prints, and her dog Rose. Elmo draws his red fur, orange nose, a piano, and watering a flower with Abby because being a kind neighbor is part of Elmo’s identity. Tamir draws his brown skin, coily hair, comic books, and some veggies as he loves gardening in the community garden. There are so many special things that make you, you!

programme.title: A Very Special Love
programme.desc: Laida Magtalas is a modern-day Belle who works hard to provide for her family while hoping that someday she will meet her prince charming and that they will live happily ever after together. That would-be prince charming is none other than \"Miggy\", the youngest member of the Montenegro clan — a well established family in the business world. Moony Laida's desire to finally meet Miggy leads her to apply as an Editorial Assistant at his newly launched men’s magazine, \"Bachelor\". In spite of the fact that a relationship with Miggy may prove to be a long shot, Laida revels working in such close proximity with the man of her dreams.

programme.title: CSI S5 E02 - Down the Drain
programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides (\"Nesting Dolls\"), infantism (\"King Baby\"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido (\"Snakes\"). It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover’s death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Elimination Game
programme.desc: Navy SEAL Rick is sentenced to rot in a military prison until he is offered the opportunity to put his life on the line and win his freedom in a kill or be killed reality show. Rick will have to eliminate some of the world's most notorious killers on live TV to gain his freedom and clear his name. Can he succeed finally?

programme.title: 10 Fight 10 Season 3
programme.desc: The show brings Thai superstars, singers, boxers, models and rappers into the celebrity boxing ring. Season 2 features a first ever Thai female match and Season 3 has two Olympics gold medalists competing for the championship. This unique boxing show offers all-round entertainment, with live performances, lavish costumes and real fights with blood!

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn….

This spectacular adventure pits the world's most famous monster against malevolent creatures that, bolstered by humanity's scientific arrogance, threaten our very existence.

programme.title: Justice League (2017)
programme.desc: Fueled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists the help of his newfound ally, Diana Prince, to face an even greater enemy. Together, Batman and Wonder Woman work quickly to find and recruit a team of metahumans to stand against this newly awakened threat. But despite the formation of this unprecedented league of heroes – Batman, Wonder Woman, Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash – it may already be too late to save the planet from an assault of catastrophic proportions.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside us, it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In Billy Batson’s (Asher Angel) case, by shouting out one word—SHAZAM!—this streetwise 14-year-old foster kid can turn into the adult Super Hero Shazam (Zachary Levi), courtesy of an ancient wizard (Djimon Hounsou). Still a kid at heart—inside a ripped, godlike body—Shazam revels in this adult version of himself by doing what any teen would do with superpowers: have fun with them! Can he fly? Does he have X-ray vision? Can he shoot lightning out of his hands? Can he skip his social studies test? Shazam sets out to test the limits of his abilities with the joyful recklessness of a child. But he’ll need to master these powers quickly in order to fight the deadly forces of evil controlled by Dr. Thaddeus Sivana (Mark Strong).

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai. DiCaprio stars as Danny Archer, a mercenary smuggler searching for a priceless diamond amid the chaos of Sierra Leone's civil war; Hounsou (Gladiator), as a desperate father searching for his lost son; and Connelly (A Beautiful Mind), as a reporter searching for the truth behind the trade in 'conflict diamonds.' Forced to confront the brutal human cost of the diamond trade, Archer changes his search for financial reward to a quest for redemption.

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Your mind is the scene of the crime. Box-office superstar Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this contemporary science fiction action film set \"within the architecture of the mind.\" Written, directed and produced by Oscar and Golden Globe nominee Christopher Nolan (The Dark Knight, Batman Begins, The Prestige), this eagerly awaited follow-up to 2008's billion-dollar blockbuster is yet another visionary tale from a startingly original filmmaker who continually raises the bar with every film he makes. Shooting in London, Paris, Tangiers, Calgary and Los Angeles, Nolan's mind-bending film also stars Academy Award winners Michael Caine and Marion Cotillard, in addition to Juno's Ellen Page, Batman Begins' Cillian Murphy and Oscar nominees Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai) and Tom Berenger (Platoon).

programme.title: Get Smart
programme.desc: Comic superstar Steve Carell takes on the role of Agent Maxwell Smart and Anne Hathaway steps into the shoes of sexy Agent 99 as the two superspies out to save the world from the nefarious forces of KAOS in this romp based on the classic television show created by Mel Brooks and Buck Henry.

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Guillermo del Toro (Pan's Labyrinth) brings out the big guns in this sci-fi action epic about a ragtag band of humans that band together in the year 2025 to fight legions of monstrous creatures rising from the sea. Using massive piloted robots to combat the alien threat, earth's survivors (including Charlie Hunnam, Charlie Day \u0026 Rinko Kikuchi) take the fight to the invading alien force lurking in the depths of the Pacific Ocean. Nearly defenseless in the face of the relentless enemy, the forces of mankind have no choice but to turn to two unlikely heroes -- a washed up former pilot and an untested trainee -- who now stand as earth's final hope against the mounting apocalypse.

programme.title: The Legend Of Tarzan (2016)
programme.desc: A new live-action adventure from director David Yates (Harry Potter films) brings Edgar Rice Burroughs' legendary character back to the big screen. It's been years since the man once known as Tarzan (Alexander Skarsgard --True Blood) left the jungles of Africa behind for a gentrified life as John Clayton III, Lord Greystoke, with his beloved wife, Jane (Margot Robbie --The Wolf of Wall Street) at his side. Now, he has been invited back to the Congo to serve as a trade emissary of Parliament, unaware that he is a pawn in a deadly convergence of greed and revenge, masterminded by the Belgian, Captain Leon Rom (Oscar® winner Christoph Waltz). But those behind the murderous plot have no idea what they are about to unleash.

programme.title: King Arthur: Legend Of The Sword
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Guy Ritchie brings his dynamic style to the epic fantasy action adventure \"King Arthur: Legend of the Sword.\" Starring Charlie Hunnam in the title role, the film is an iconoclastic take on the classic Excalibur myth, tracing Arthur's journey from the streets to the throne. When the child Arthur's father is murdered, Vortigern (Jude Law), Arthur's uncle, seizes the crown. Robbed of his birthright and with no idea who he truly is, Arthur comes up the hard way in the back alleys of the city. But once he pulls the sword from the stone, his life is turned upside down and he is forced to acknowledge his true legacy...whether he likes it or not.

programme.title: The Woman King

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Deckard Shaw berusaha membalaskan dendamnya kepada Dominic Toretto dan keluarganya untuk saudaranya yang sedang terbaring koma.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: Dua tentara saingan yang terbunuh di Vietnam dihidupkan kembali dalam sebuah eksperimen militer nan sangat rahasia demi menciptakan para prajurit berkekuatan super.

programme.title: Back To The Future 3
programme.desc: Marty McFly kembali ke tahun 1885 untuk mencegah agar rekannya, Doktor Emmet Brown, tidak tewas di tangan Buford 'Mad Dog' Tannen!

programme.title: Around The World In 80 Days
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1872, seorang penemu asal Inggris, pencuri asal Tiongkok, dan seniman asal Prancis berkeliling dunia dalam waktu 80 hari via jalur darat, udara, dan laut menggunakan sepatu roda untuk mencapai tujuan mereka.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Di Inggris pada abad ke-12, Robin dan kelompok perampoknya menghadapi korupsi di desa setempat dan memimpin pemberontakan melawan penguasa yang nantinya akan mengubah keseimbangan kekuasaan di dunia.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme harus memperdaya sebuah grup yang membunuh manusia demi kepuasan pribadi.

programme.title: U-571
programme.desc: Terinspirasi oleh peristiwa nyata pada masa Perang Dunia II, film ini bercerita tentang awak kapal selam Amerika yang ditugaskan menangkap kapal selam Jerman yang membawa mesin sandi Enigma.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Lima teman masa kecil bersatu kembali dua puluh tahun setelah mereka mencoba mabuk-mabukan di beberapa bar sekaligus dalam semalam dan berusaha untuk mendatangi sebuah bar legendaris: The World's End.

programme.title: Tears Of The Sun
programme.desc: Seorang anggota Navy SEAL ditugaskan untuk menyelamatkan seorang dokter Amerika yang terdampar di perang yang melanda Nigeria, namun ia menghadapi banyak masalah yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Captain Phillips
programme.desc: Kapal Maersk Alabama yang tengah menuju Kenya dibajak oleh sekelompok perompak Somalia yang dipimpin oleh Abduwali Muse. Namun tak lama kemudian, Muse dan kapten kapal tersebut terjebak dalam situasi nan ekstrem.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen dan Peeta Mellark menjadi incaran Capitol setelah kemenangan mereka di Hunger Games ke-74 memicu aksi pemberontakan di semua distrik di Panem.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Will Smith dan Martin Lawrence berperan sebagai dua polisi Miami yang harus bertukar identitas untuk melacak seorang pencuri heroin dan menyelamatkan departemen tempat mereka bertugas.

programme.title: Back To The Future 3
programme.desc: Marty McFly kembali ke tahun 1885 untuk mencegah agar rekannya, Doktor Emmet Brown, tidak tewas di tangan Buford 'Mad Dog' Tannen!

programme.title: Bad Boys 2
programme.desc: Bad Boys kembali beraksi untuk menghancurkan perdagangan narkoba di Miami.

programme.title: The Librarian: King Solomon
programme.desc: Film ini bercerita tentang seorang pustakawan yang beralih profesi menjadi petualang bernama Flynn Carsen dalam upayanya untuk menemukan tambang Raja Solomon.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Tom Cruise berperan sebagai seorang tentara AS yang harus menghentikan terjadinya pembinasaan umat manusia akibat kebangkitan seorang putri dari zaman kuno yang telah memendam kedengkian selama ribuan tahun.

programme.title: Moby Dick, Pt 1
programme.desc: Satu-satunya orang yang selamat dari sebuah kapal penangkap ikan paus yang hilang menceritakan kisah tentang obsesi kapten kapalnya untuk berburu seekor paus putih, Moby Dick.

programme.title: Moby Dick, Pt 2
programme.desc: Satu-satunya orang yang selamat dari sebuah kapal penangkap ikan paus yang hilang menceritakan kisah tentang obsesi kapten kapalnya untuk berburu seekor paus putih, Moby Dick.

programme.title: Tai Chi Master
programme.desc: Dua sahabat mengambil jalan berbeda saat terseret dalam pemberontakan melawan pemerintah. Salah satunya tumbuh menjadi komandan militer, sementara yang lain memilih mempelajari teknik Tai Chi yang menenangkan.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Dalam film nan penuh kejutan ini, Hobbs dan Shaw bekerja sama untuk menghentikan seorang penjahat super yang memiliki senjata biologis nan mematikan.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Seorang polisi tangguh, John Kimble, menghadapi tantangan terberatnya saat ia harus menyamar sebagai seorang guru Taman Kanak-kanak demi menangkap seorang bandar narkoba.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Seorang mantan ahli hewan militer turun tangan saat suatu taman hiburan yang berisi sekawanan dinosaurus hasil rekayasa genetika berubah mengerikan bagi para wisatawan karena salah satu dinosaurus lepas dari kandang.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgement Day
programme.desc: Sesosok siborg nan identik dengan siborg yang gagal membunuh Sarah Connor kini harus melindungi putranya yang berusia sepuluh tahun, John, dari siborg lain yang lebih canggih dan kuat.

programme.title: The Man With The Iron Fists
programme.desc: Saat berburu harta karun emas, sekelompok prajurit, pembunuh, dan seorang pembelot asal Inggris pergi ke sebuah desa di Tiongkok dan bertemu seorang pandai besi baik hati yang tengah berjuang mempertahankan desanya.

programme.title: Wanted

programme.desc: Nicholas bekerja sebagai dokter gigi di Kanada. Namun, ia menghadapi kesulitan kala mengetahui bahwa tetangga barunya adalah Jimmy Tudeski, seorang pembunuh bayaran yang juga dikenal sebagai Jimmy Si Tulip.

programme.title: Hitch
programme.desc: Seorang 'pakar kencan' berusaha membantu seorang klien merayu wanita impiannya. Namun, ia sendiri justru kesulitan merebut hati seorang wanita penulis kolom gosip yang telah membuatnya tergila-gila.

programme.title: Spy Kids: All Time In The World
programme.desc: Anak-anak tiri dari seorang mantan mata-mata harus kembali beraksi untuk menghentikan Timekeeper jahat yang ingin mengambil alih dunia.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: Saksikan aksi petualangan spektakuler dari sekelompok mantan juara video gim dari tahun 1980-an yang bersatu untuk menyelamatkan dunia dari invasi alien.

programme.title: A Man Called Otto
programme.desc: Seorang duda yang pemarah menjalin persahabatan yang tak biasa dengan para tetangga baru yang berhasil mengubah dunianya.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Seorang pengusaha mengundang tim ahli untuk mengunjungi taman miliknya yang dihuni dinosaurus hasil kloning. Namun, putusnya listrik membuat dinosaurus lepas dan mengancam nyawa semua orang, termasuk cucu-cucunya.

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: Seorang arsitek pekerja keras menemukan sebuah remote control yang memungkinkannya untuk mempercepat atau mengulang beberapa momen dalam hidupnya.

programme.title: Miami Vice
programme.desc: Ketika detektif Ricardo Tubbs dan Sonny Crockett diminta untuk menyelidiki pembunuhan brutal dua agen federal, mereka mendapati diri mereka tertarik ke dalam dunia pengedar narkoba nan memikat dan mematikan.

programme.title: The Whole Nine Yards
programme.desc: Nicholas bekerja sebagai dokter gigi di Kanada. Namun, ia menghadapi kesulitan kala mengetahui bahwa tetangga barunya adalah Jimmy Tudeski, seorang pembunuh bayaran yang juga dikenal sebagai Jimmy Si Tulip.

programme.title: The Last Dragonslayer
programme.desc: Film fantasi petualangan ini berlatar di dunia tempat sihir digantikan oleh teknologi dan berkisah tentang seorang anak yatim piatu saat ia dengan enggan menemukan takdirnya untuk menjadi The Last Dragonslayer.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Setelah invasi hantu di Manhattan, penggemar paranormal Erin Gilbert dan Abby Yates, insinyur nuklir Jillian Holtzmann, dan petugas kereta bawah tanah Patty Tolan, bekerjasama untuk menghentikan ancaman dari dunia roh.

programme.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village
programme.desc: Smurfette dan Brainy, Clumsy, serta Hefty berada dalam sebuah perlombaan nan menebarkan dan menegangkan melalui Hutan Terlarang demi menemukan desa yang hilang.

programme.title: Twin Dragons
programme.desc: Seorang musisi di New York dan seorang mekanik di Hong Kong adalah saudara kembar yang terpisah sejak kecil. Namun, mereka bertemu kembali secara tak terduga ketika sang musisi datang ke Hong Kong untuk konser.

programme.title: Zathura: A Space Adventure
programme.desc: Dua bersaudara terjebak dalam sebuah petualangan antargalaksi saat rumah mereka terhempas secara ajaib ke ruang angkasa.

programme.title: The Legend Of Zorro
programme.desc: Meski tengah berusaha hidup tenang, ancaman terhadap rencana California yang akan diubah menjadi negara bagian memaksa Alejandro de la Vega yang gemar berpetualang dan istrinya, Elena, untuk kembali beraksi.
